name: forge-2.0 rate model
about: Current published Jira rate-limit cost classes and request/write-window semantics, adapted to a disclosed normalized 2,400-point virtual installation. Bucket capacities and virtual reset policy are benchmark assumptions; they are not production Forge entitlements.

quota.scope: per installation, per virtual hour: a clock hour of the virtual clock (minute :00 to :00), not counted from the upgrade or from a scheduled run
quota.reset: at the top of each virtual hour (minute :00); nothing carries over
quota.wall: hard: once the hour's points are spent, every request the quota charges is answered 429 until the reset (a Custom UI page's own requestJira is never charged)
quota.why: the app's fair share of its 65,000-point Tier 1 hourly pool, which every tenant of the app shares (about 27 tenants)

background.rule: background requests may use at most 70 % of any virtual hour's quota (the admin setting Background share (%) moves this limit, 10-90)

is: resolvers invoked from a UI surface (Custom UI or UI Kit)
personFacing.rule: a person-facing request is never refused for quota

costs.request: read operations, including POST search, bulkfetch and precomputation search
costs.points: 1 + number of returned top-level domain records (identity/access records cost 2 each)
costs.singleObject: counts as one domain record; nested fields/changes do not add records

costs.request: mutating POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE

burst.bucket: method + path template; one request token per call, independent of point cost
burst.capacityNote: Jira publishes request rates, not its buffer capacity. This normalized harness starts with one second of request allowance.

perIssueWrites.rule: Both rolling windows apply; successful bulk operations count once for every referenced issue.

reasons.jira-per-issue-on-write: either per-issue rolling write window exceeded

reactions.jira-quota-tenant-based: pause ALL background requests until the reset
reactions.jira-per-issue-on-write: delay writes to that issue only
reactions.always: never send the next attempt before Retry-After has passed
reactions.jira-quota-global-based: pause ALL background requests until the reset
